data.gender_notes: Purushotam is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Purushotam is recorded with the meaning “Lord of all”. Purushotam is a Hindu name meaning “Lord of all”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_hindi.name: पुरुषोत्तम
in_hindi.long_meaning: पुरुष (puruṣa) - pūrush, man, उत्तम (uttama) - uttam, best, supreme

in_telugu.name: పురుషోదృశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: పురుషః (puruṣa) - man, దృశ్ (dṛṣṭi) - vision, best, supreme

in_marathi.name: Purushotam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of all
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purushotam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। He who possesses all (God)

in_bengali.name: Purushotam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of all
in_bengali.long_meaning: Purushotam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। He who possesses all (God)
